versions.changelog:
Initial release: Persona-switcher skill enables dynamic persona switching with persistent state and self-improvement compatibility.

- Supports automatic and manual persona switching: asset advisor, grad mentor, code expert, project expert, general.
- Each persona has independent rule/config files, self-improvement space, and shared general improvements.
- Seamless compatibility with self-improving-agent: persona-tagged learning and error records, shared improvements for cross-persona learning.
- Lightweight routing design: only loads necessary persona data per interaction.
- Clear processes and utilities for state tracking, persona switching, and custom personality extension.
